player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Harakat 0-8 raqamlari bilan [macro micro] shaklida bo'lishi kerak.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Har bir indeks 0 va 8 orasida bo'lishi kerak.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mikro_panel, satr yoki ustun masofadan tashqarida.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: O'yinchi keyingi mikro taxtada o'ynashi kerak.

game_action.played: O'yinchi {player_id} mikrokartonda {macro_idx}, hujayrada {micro_idx} (satr {row}, ustun {col}) o'ynagan. O'yinchi {opponent_id} endi {nxt_txt}da o'ynashi kerak.

outcome.win: O'yinchi {player_id} Ultimate Tic Tac Toe-da g'olib bo'ldi!
